body:
Review pass 4. Verified your two closures independently rather than taking the notes at face value - both hold up.

$C3 coordinate_cells - CONFIRMED FIXED, better than your note claims.
  before: p=8000 1.29s (162 us/vox) | p=27000 6.29s (233) | p=50653 14.55s (287)
  after : p=8000 0.38s ( 48 us/vox) | p=27000 1.53s ( 57) | p=50653  2.64s ( 52)
us/voxel is now FLAT (48/57/52), so the O(p x n_groups) term is genuinely gone, not just reduced. I measure 2.64s where your note says 3.18s. volume_stencil also improved, 24.1 -> 20.2 us/vox at p=97336.

Regression-checked the rewrite for correctness - all still exact vs brute force: six mask topologies (full iso, anisotropic, 35% random, disconnected, slab, radius<spacing) and the union pair pattern on full/sparse/slab. Then nine NEW coordinate edge cases aimed at the mixed-radix encoding, all exact: MNI-like centred negatives, all-negative quadrant, mixed-sign anisotropic scaling, non-integer jitter, 2D surface-like, one axis scaled x1000, duplicate coordinates, single point. No encoding failures found.

$C4 preflight - CONFIRMED FIXED. p=55296, r=8.1mm: 2.35 GiB per edge (matches manual 8*sum(k^2) = 2.351), 18.81 GiB total at 8 edges, lowering correctly flips materializable -> support_streamed_only, evaluation_edges=0 rejected. metric_schedule_storage = derive_on_demand_from_frozen_recipe is exactly the frozen-not-materialised distinction. Good.

Epic 3 in flight - whitener provenance is CORRECT. identity, explicit diag(n), and two distinct AR whiteners all give different diagnostics$observation_whitener signatures; a numerically-equal explicit diag(n) is correctly NOT identified with the identity path. Maps bitwise identical across the alias; GLS/OLS match base qr.coef to 1.5e-16 / 8.3e-17. Identity path skips materialising diag(n) with no numerical change.

ONE new defect, $C5 (p2): legacy_supplied = !missing(whiten) fires on an explicit whiten = NULL, so lm_extractor(X, C, whiten = NULL) and do.call with a full argument list both warn spuriously. Result is correct, warning is not. Under testthat edition 3 this shows up as unexplained downstream failures. One-line fix in the bead.

Still open and unacked: $C1 (p0) frame/metric composition + conservation law, and $C2 K-inverse handle action. Both are Epic 2 prerequisites - $C1 decides what 'a' is.
